native_result.query: In which century did summed social capital peak, what individual social capital components like gold, monument etc increase?
native_result.HypoA: From 1500 BCE onwards, Monuments Count and Copper & Gold increase simultaneuosly while summer social capital peaks?
native_result.HypoB: Суммарный социальный капитал (сумма Z-оценок медь+золото ZCU_AU, янтарь Zamber, число монументов ZMonument) достиг пика (S=4.24) в 14-м и 13-м веках до н.э. (BCE 1400 и 1300 — плато, ~1400–1300 до н.э.). В подъём к пику (переход 15→14 в. до н.э.) росли все три компонента: медь и золото (−0.36→2.54), янтарь (−0.15→−0.01) и число монументов (0.17→1.71); в веках пика они удерживали максимальные для эпохи уровни (медь+золото 2.54 и монументы 1.71 — основной вклад), хотя абсолютные максимумы отдельных серий приходятся на другие века.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1) capital.csv: замена десятичной запятой на точку, проверка на NaN (0); 2) S(b)=ZCU_AU+Zamber+ZMonument на 39 100-летних бинах; 3) argmax → плато BCE 1400/1300 (S=4.238); 4) кросс-проверка с сырыми 37 бинами time_series_data (max|Δ|=0.0) и с интерполированным годовым рядом (rolling 100-летнее среднее: пик ≈ BCE 1301, годовая сумма: BCE 1400); 5) рост компонент — к началу плато (1500→1400) и за ~300 лет (1700→1400); все три компонента растут; собственные максимумы серий в других веках.

sub_hypo.text: From 1500 BCE onwards, Monument Count and Copper & Gold increase simultaneously while summer social capital peaks.
sub_hypo.relations: Monument Count and Copper & Gold increase simultaneously while summer social capital peaks; no column is explicitly identified for summer social capital.

gold_sub_hypo.full_hypo: From 1500 BCE onwards, Monuments Count and Copper & Gold increase simultaneuosly while summer social capital peaks?

sub_hypo.text: Total social capital, defined as the sum of the Z-scores for copper and gold, amber, and monument count, reached a peak plateau of S = 4.238 (approximately 4.24) at BCE 1400 and 1300.
sub_hypo.context: Prehistoric archaeological capital data across 39 100-year bins; peak plateau at approximately 1400–1300 BCE.
sub_hypo.relations: S(BCE) = ZCU_AU + Zamber + ZMonument; its maximum is shared by the BCE 1400 and 1300 bins.

sub_hypo.text: All three social-capital components increased toward the peak plateau, both from BCE 1500 to 1400 and over approximately 300 years from BCE 1700 to 1400. From BCE 1500 to 1400, copper and gold increased from −0.36 to 2.54, amber from −0.15 to −0.01, and monument count from 0.17 to 1.71.
sub_hypo.context: The rise preceding the social-capital peak in prehistoric archaeological capital data: BCE 1500→1400 and BCE 1700→1400.
sub_hypo.relations: All three component Z-scores increase toward the beginning of the peak plateau.

sub_hypo.text: During the BCE 1400–1300 peak plateau, the components maintained their highest levels for that epoch, with copper and gold at 2.54 and monument count at 1.71 providing the main contributions to total social capital; the absolute maxima of the individual series occurred in other centuries.
sub_hypo.context: BCE 1400 and 1300 in prehistoric archaeological capital data, compared with the individual component series across other centuries.
sub_hypo.relations: Copper and gold and monument count dominate the summed peak. The maximum of the sum does not coincide with the absolute maxima of the individual component series.

sub_hypo.text: The social-capital peak was cross-checked against 37 raw time-series bins and an interpolated annual series: the raw-bin sums matched exactly, the 100-year rolling mean peaked at approximately BCE 1301, and the annual sum peaked at BCE 1400.
sub_hypo.context: Cross-checking capital.csv against the 37 raw bins of time_series_data and its interpolated annual series.
sub_hypo.relations: Corresponding raw component sums have max|Δ| = 0.0; the interpolated annual sum peaks at BCE 1400 and its 100-year rolling mean peaks at approximately BCE 1301.

Malformed judge output raises an evaluation error; no hidden retries.
evaluator_config.aggregation: recall_context * mean_accuracy_score; unmatched predicted contexts stay in denominator
evaluator_config.native_behavior_preserved: Variable/relation comparisons receive full hypotheses for each matched context pair.

details.score_scope: Reference agreement of submitted hypothesis; execution is not independently verified by this native metric.
